{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Compute the raw difference in response rates (treatment minus control)
treatment_response_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_response_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

# Print the result
print(treatment_effect)"}
